categories.name: Property Development

categories.name: Property Valuation
categories.description: Property valuation is the professional process of estimating a real estate asset's monetary worth (market value) by assessing its features (size, condition, location), market trends, and comparable sales.

categories.name: Vastu Consultancy
categories.description: A Vastu Consultancy offers expert guidance in applying Vastu Shastra, the ancient Indian science of architecture, to harmonize living/working spaces with natural energies (earth, water, fire, air, space)

categories.name: Environmental Clearance
categories.description: Environmental Clearance (EC) is a mandatory government approval process, primarily under India's EIA Notification 2006, requiring developers to assess and mitigate potential negative impacts of large projects.

categories.name: Ground water Consultancy
categories.description: A groundwater consultancy provides expert services for sustainable management, development, and protection of underground water resources, involving hydrogeological studies, water quality/quantity assessment.

categories.name: Construction Project Management
categories.description: Construction Project Management (CPM) is the professional service of planning, coordinating, and overseeing a construction project from inception to completion

sub_categories.name: Carpentry Repairs

sub_categories.name: Masonry & Civil Repairs

services.name: Property Inspection
services.description: Property inspection services involve a thorough examination of a property's condition by a qualified professional, typically before a real estate transaction. The inspector assesses various aspects of the property, including its structure, systems (like electrical and plumbing), and overall condition, to identify potential issues, needed repairs, or maintenance. This process helps buyers make informed decisions and protects sellers by revealing any problems that need addressing.

services.name: Architectural Services
services.description: Architectural designing services encompass the conceptualization, planning, design, and documentation of buildings and other structures to meet client needs for functionality, aesthetics, and safety, often involving detailed drawings, material selection, and compliance with regulatory standards.

services.name: Legal Service
services.description: Legal services are professional legal assistance, which includes providing advice on any legal matter, conducting cases in courts or tribunals, and preparing legal documents like appeals and paper books. In India, the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987, mandates the provision of free and competent legal services to weaker sections of society to ensure equal access to justice. This includes activities like conducting Lok Adalats for dispute resolution, spreading legal literacy, and offering free legal aid to eligible citizens.

services.name: SELL PROPERTY
services.description: A sell property service guides homeowners through a property sale by handling legalities, marketing, buyer interaction, and negotiations to secure the best deal and ensure a smooth, legal transfer of ownership. Key components include document verification, property marketing with appealing visuals, buyer qualification, sale agreement preparation, legal registration, and managing post-sale requirements.

services.name: BUY PROPERTY
services.description: Buy property services" refers to professional assistance from real estate agents, brokers, or agencies that help clients find, evaluate, negotiate, and purchase residential, commercial, or industrial real estate. These services encompass activities such as market analysis, property listings, legal documentation, property registration, and negotiation to facilitate a smooth and profitable transaction for the client.

services.name: Tenant Verification
services.description: A tenant verification service is a process or company that performs background checks on prospective tenants for property owners to ensure the safety and reliability of a tenant before renting out a property. It involves verifying a tenant's identity, address, and employment, and conducting criminal record checks and reference checks, often with police involvement, to prevent fraud, property damage, and other risks to the landlord and the property.

services.name: Structure Design
services.description: Structure design services involve a civil engineering process where structural engineers analyze, design, and detail structural elements like beams, columns, and foundations to ensure a building or infrastructure project is safe, stable, durable, and cost-effective. These services ensure structures can withstand all anticipated loads, including self-weight, environmental forces like wind and seismic activity, and operational use, all while adhering to relevant building codes and regulations. The outcome is detailed construction drawings and specifications that enable the creation of a robust and functional structure.

services.name: Investment Consulting
services.description: Investment consulting services involve professional guidance to individuals, corporations, and institutions on financial planning, strategy, and portfolio management to achieve their financial goals. Consultants assess a client's financial situation, risk tolerance, and objectives to develop customized, long-term investment plans, monitor market trends, and recommend specific investment vehicles such as stocks, bonds, and real estate. These services aim to help clients manage risk, maximize returns, and ensure their investments align with their evolving financial needs.
